job.title: Customer Services Advisor
job.description:
CUSTOMER SERVICES ADVISOR
Nottingham | £26,000-£28,000 DOE | Full-time | Hybrid after probation
 
The Animal People Recruitment Company is delighted to be partnering once again with a rapidly growing pet brand. Our client is expanding its customer service team and looking for someone who is passionate about the pet industry and takes real pride in helping customers.
 
This is a predominantly email-based role where you'll manage customer enquiries from start to finish. You'll investigate problems, work with different departments and make sure every customer receives a warm, helpful and accurate response.
 
What you'll be doing:
  • Managing a busy customer service inbox
  • Responding to enquiries clearly, warmly and professionally
  • Helping customers with products, sizing, orders and deliveries
  • Managing returns, replacements, refunds and complaints
  • Taking ownership of enquiries through to resolution
  • Contacting customers proactively about stock or delivery issues
  • Updating customer and order information accurately
  • Working with warehouse and fulfilment colleagues to resolve problems
  • Assessing product faults using photographs and returned items
  • Escalating unusual or complex enquiries when required
  • Identifying recurring issues and sharing customer feedback
  • Supporting the wider business and retail shop when needed
What we're looking for:
  • Previous customer service experience
  • Excellent written English
  • A warm, natural and empathetic communication style
  • Strong organisation and attention to detail
  • The ability to prioritise a busy workload
  • Confidence learning new systems and processes
  • A calm approach to complaints and frustrated customers
  • Reliability, self-motivation and a strong work ethic
  • Someone who enjoys taking ownership without being micromanaged
  • A genuine passion for dogs, pets and the wider pet industry
We're open to people from ecommerce, pet retail, independent retail, veterinary reception, dog daycare, hospitality, store management, fulfilment or other customer-focused environments.
Experience with Shopify, Gorgias or online orders would be useful, but it isn't essential if you learn quickly and write exceptionally well.
What's on offer:
  • Salary of £26,000-£28,000 depending on experience
  • Monday to Friday, 8.00am-4.00pm
  • 37.5 hours per week
  • Up to two days working from home following successful probation and training
  • Employee discount
  • Company pension
  • Full product and systems training
  • Company-funded social events and Christmas celebrations
  • Development opportunities within a growing international pet brand
If you love the pet industry, enjoy solving problems and want your work to have a visible impact, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply with your CV or contact The Animal People Recruitment Company for a confidential conversation.

job.title: Business Development Manager - National
job.description:
BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT MANAGER – COMPANION ANIMAL
Home-based, ideally Midlands or Central England
National UK territory £40,000–£45,000 + bonus + company car

The Animal People are incredibly proud to have been selected as the exclusive recruitment partner for this fantastic new client and to launch our first search together.

Our client is a globally respected manufacturer with an outstanding reputation for premium products across the animal sector. With an established UK customer base and exciting plans for growth, they’re now looking for a Business Development Manager to take ownership of their companion-animal category.
This is not a rigid territory sales role. You’ll have the freedom to manage your own diary, build meaningful customer relationships and influence the future direction of the division.

THE OPPORTUNITY

You’ll manage and develop an established portfolio of approximately 34 B2B accounts while opening new opportunities across professional dog grooming and veterinary wholesale.
The professional grooming market will be your main focus, working with groomers, distributors, retailers, wholesalers and grooming academies. You’ll also develop opportunities with veterinary wholesalers, buying groups and larger veterinary organisations.
Your responsibilities will include:
  • Developing existing accounts and identifying further growth opportunities
  • Winning new business across professional grooming and veterinary wholesale
  • Delivering product demonstrations and customer training
  • Increasing brand awareness across salons, academies and distributors
  • Representing the business at trade shows, grooming competitions and industry events
  • Monitoring competitor activity and sharing market insight
  • Creating a clear and sustainable growth plan for the category
  • Helping to identify opportunities for future product development
  • Working closely with the National Sales Manager and wider UK team
THE PRODUCTS

You’ll represent a premium portfolio that includes clippers, trimmers, blades, comb guards, blade-care products, professional shampoos and grooming accessories.
You’ll also have the opportunity to recommend new products and influence future additions to the range based on customer demand and commercial potential.

ABOUT YOU

We’re looking for someone who combines commercial drive with warmth, credibility and a genuine understanding of the customer.
You’re likely to bring:
  • Proven success in field sales, business development, account management or territory growth
  • Experience within professional grooming, pet, animal health, veterinary or companion-animal sales
  • The confidence to demonstrate technical products and train customers
  • Experience developing existing accounts and securing new business
  • Strong commercial awareness and the ability to manage opportunities from prospecting through to close
  • Excellent relationship-building, presentation and communication skills
  • The organisation and motivation to manage a national territory independently
  • A full UK driving licence
Existing relationships within the professional dog-grooming market would be highly valuable. However, we’re also interested in talented people from adjacent markets who understand distributor or wholesale sales and can quickly develop the necessary product knowledge.

LOCATION AND WORKING PATTERN

This is a genuinely home and field-based position with no regular head-office requirement.

The successful person can be based flexibly, although the Midlands or Central England would offer the most practical access to customers across the UK.
You’ll be trusted to manage your own diary and travel according to customer needs. The business doesn’t expect you to spend five days a week on the road unnecessarily.

THE PACKAGE
  • £40,000–£45,000 basic salary, with potential flexibility for an exceptional candidate
  • Achievable performance-related bonus
  • Company car, with a degree of choice based on practical requirements
  • 25 days’ holiday plus bank holidays
  • Pension
  • Laptop and mobile phone
  • Comprehensive product training
  • Home and field-based working
  • Attendance at leading industry events
  • Genuine ownership of an established category with significant growth potential
WHY CONSIDER IT?

This is an opportunity to represent premium products that customers already know and trust while putting your own stamp on a division with real potential.
You’ll join a supportive and down-to-earth UK team that values autonomy, sensible travel and honest communication. You’ll be trusted to manage the territory, influence the product range and build the category as though it were your own business.

The right person could join as soon as they’re available, with the business ideally hoping to have someone in place before Christmas.

The Animal People are managing this search exclusively and will provide every candidate with a clear, honest and personal experience throughout the process.
If you’re ready to take ownership of an exciting national opportunity within the companion-animal market, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today or contact Katie Fletcher at The Animal People for a confidential conversation.

job.title: Trade & Brand Marketing Lead
job.description:
Trade & Brand Marketing Lead Premium Pet Industry | Staffordshire | Up to £45,000 + Bonus | Hybrid

Can you lead the marketing, champion it internally AND still roll your sleeves up and make things happen?

We're working exclusively with one of the UK's most respected premium pet brands to find a Trade & Brand Marketing Lead who can take ownership of an established brand and help shape the next stage of its growth.

This isn't a role for someone who wants to sit purely at strategy level.
It's for someone who can see the bigger picture, bring people together around it and then make sure it actually happens.

The opportunity This is a broad, commercially focused marketing role within an independently owned, growing pet business.

Around two-thirds of the business comes through trade, so you'll work closely with sales, retailers, wholesalers and buying groups, while also helping develop the wider consumer brand.

You'll take the lead across trade and brand marketing; campaigns; product launches; retail activation; PR; events; digital activity and external agencies.
But there's another important part to this role.

You'll be an advocate for marketing across the wider business.

You'll need the confidence to work with senior stakeholders, challenge appropriately, make the commercial case for marketing priorities and secure the support and resource needed to deliver them.

Resources aren't unlimited, so we're looking for someone who knows how to prioritise, delegate and get the best from the people around them.

What you'll be doing You'll lead and coordinate marketing activity across trade, brand, digital and events; build marketing plans around wider commercial objectives; work closely with sales and account teams to support retailers and customers; lead campaigns and product launches from idea through to execution; manage budgets and demonstrate ROI; oversee agencies and external partners; develop POS, trade press, editorial and PR activity; and help create clear priorities, ownership and accountability across the marketing function.

You'll also play an important role in developing the people around you, bringing different areas of marketing together and ensuring everyone understands what needs to happen, who owns it and when it needs to be delivered.

Who we're looking for You might already be a Trade Marketing Manager, Brand Marketing Manager, Marketing Manager, Senior Marketing Manager or Head of Marketing within a smaller business.

Your title matters less than the level you're operating at.

We're looking for someone who can demonstrate strong trade and/or brand marketing experience; leadership or people management; confidence influencing senior stakeholders; commercial decision-making; budget ownership; campaign and project leadership; excellent organisation and prioritisation; and the ability to move comfortably between strategy and hands-on delivery.

Experience within pet, pet food, animal health, veterinary, premium FMCG, food & drink, nutrition, retail or another consumer brand would be particularly relevant.

Direct pet industry experience would be fantastic, but it isn't essential. We're equally interested in people who can bring fresh thinking from another sector and genuinely want to build their career within pet.
About the business They're an established, independently owned premium pet brand with an excellent reputation.

Their products are trusted by retailers, breeders, industry professionals and thousands of pet owners across the UK.

They've built that reputation through education, integrity and helping pet owners make informed decisions, rather than sensational marketing or shouting louder than everyone else.

There's already a strong brand, brilliant content, passionate people and plenty of ideas.
What they now need is somebody who can bring all of that together and create momentum.

What you'll receive Salary up to £45,000 DOE plus performance-related bonus; hybrid working with three days per week in the Staffordshire office and two from home; generous annual leave with additional service-related holiday; Christmas shutdown; workplace pension; Employee Assistance Programme; staff discount; pet-friendly office; professional development and free parking.

Why this role stands out You'll have genuine ownership and visibility.
You'll work directly with senior leaders and have the opportunity to influence how marketing develops as the business grows.

This is a brilliant opportunity for somebody who has already started operating at leadership level but still loves being close enough to the work to see their ideas come to life.

If you're commercially minded, confident with people and want the opportunity to make your mark within a premium pet brand, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: Veterinary Clinical Systems Specialist
job.description:
Veterinary Clinical Systems Specialist

London Paddington (4 days office-based minimum)
Up to £80,000 + outstanding benefits package

We’re partnering with an innovative, fast-growing AI technology business that is transforming the way veterinary clinics operate through intelligent software systems, workflow optimisation, and data-driven solutions.

This is a genuinely unique opportunity to join a highly collaborative, ambitious, and forward-thinking team at a pivotal stage of growth.

The business combines cutting-edge AI capability with real-world clinical understanding to create smarter systems that improve operational efficiency, decision-making, and clinical outcomes within veterinary environments.

They are now looking for a Veterinary Clinical Systems Specialist to act as the bridge between clinical operations and technical delivery teams.

This role would suit someone who thrives in fast-paced, high-growth environments and enjoys solving complex operational problems through systems thinking, communication, and technology.

Please note you need to be a qualified Veterinary Surgeon to apply.

The Role
Working closely with AI, product, and software teams, you’ll help translate veterinary clinical workflows into scalable technical solutions and intelligent system improvements.

Our client is looking for candidates to demonstrate how they would approach the design and evaluation of an AI-enabled clinical recommendation tool. They are looking for the candidates to design a clear framework around defining success measures, evaluating outcomes, and connecting the practical requirements of the consultation room with the capabilities of an AI solution.

This is a highly visible role within the business and offers genuine ownership, influence, and progression potential.

Who you are 
  • Veterinary or Medical Degree with clinical experience
  • Experience working with clinical or healthcare data (SQL is a plus)
  • Familiarity with clinical coding systems (e.g. SNOMED, ICD)
  • Interest in LLMs and prompt engineering
  
What the job involves  
  • Evaluate and improve the performance of clinical AI models and datasets
  • Work closely with users to launch new features, capture medical feedback, and translate it into product requirements
  • Turn clinical expertise into high-quality data and evidence-based recommendations to improve care
  • Collaborate with the AI team on research initiatives (e.g. preventative healthcare, clinical decision support

The Environment
This is not a traditional corporate environment.

The company has built a collaborative, ambitious, and people-focused culture where employees are encouraged to contribute ideas, take ownership, and help shape the future of the business.

The team works closely together in person and values visibility, communication, collaboration, and shared momentum. As such, this role requires a minimum of four days per week onsite in Paddington, London.

In return, the business offers:
  • A highly competitive salary package
  • Excellent benefits and wellbeing support
  • Strong long-term growth potential
  • A social, dynamic, and collaborative culture
  • Exposure to cutting-edge AI technology
  • The opportunity to make genuine impact in a scaling business
If you’re excited by the idea of helping shape AI-powered systems within the veterinary sector and want to be part of a business entering a significant growth phase, we’d love to hear from you. Please apply to register your interest and we'll be in touch to tell you more!
